name: Unilateral hand action
description: A single hand or arm performs the primary motion while the other arm remains passive.

name: Bilateral symmetric arms
description: Both hands and arms move synchronously in a mirrored or parallel pattern.

name: Bilateral asymmetric hands
description: One hand holds or stabilizes while the other hand actively manipulates or operates.

name: Head and neck motion
description: Head tilting, nodding, shaking, or neck movement is a central part of the action.

name: Torso bending or leaning
description: The upper trunk bends, leans forward or backward, or curls noticeably.

name: Torso twisting rotation
description: Shoulders and upper torso rotate laterally relative to the hips.

name: Lower body leg action
description: Legs, knees, or feet perform stepping, kicking, squatting, or weight-shifting motion.

name: Whole-body coordination
description: Arms, trunk, and legs move together in coordinated full-body motion.

name: Mutual two-person action
description: Two people coordinate their bodies symmetrically while facing or moving together.

name: Directed two-person action
description: One person directs a physical gesture, strike, or transfer toward another person.

name: Mouth, nose, and face zone
description: The hand or action occurs directly at the mouth, nose, or front of the face.

name: Head, hair, and ear zone
description: The hand targets the top or side of the head, hair, forehead, or ears.

name: Neck and throat zone
description: The hand is positioned at the front, side, or back of the neck.

name: Chest and front torso zone
description: Hands act directly against the chest, heart, stomach, or front upper body.

name: Back and rear shoulder zone
description: Hands reach behind the torso, over the rear shoulder, or onto the lower back.

name: Front chest workspace
description: Hands manipulate objects or gesture in open space in front of the chest or lap.

name: Waist, hip, and pocket zone
description: Hands operate near the waist, side of the hip, or trouser pocket level.

name: Overhead high space
description: One or both hands are raised clearly above shoulder and head height.

name: Lateral side space
description: Arms or legs extend outward to the left or right side of the body.

name: Floor and foot level
description: Hands or body descend close to the knees, ankles, feet, or ground level.

name: Forward arm extension space
description: An arm extends straight forward away from the torso toward a distant target.

name: Interpersonal shared space
description: Motion occurs in the shared space bridging two interacting people.

name: Ballistic fast strike or launch
description: Fast, explosive striking, throwing, kicking, or swinging burst of limb velocity.

name: Rhythmic oscillatory motion
description: Repeated back-and-forth, up-and-down, or side-to-side oscillatory movement.

name: Fine wrist and finger motion
description: Small, precise, rapid micro-movements of the wrists, palms, or fingers.

name: Pushing or extending outward
description: Controlled pushing, extending, or moving limbs outward away from the body.

name: Pulling or retracting inward
description: Drawing hands, arms, or an object inward toward the body or face.

name: Lifting or rising upward
description: Upward elevation of hands, limbs, an object, or the entire body center of mass.

name: Lowering or descending downward
description: Downward motion of hands, an object, or body lowering toward the ground.

name: Circular or twisting motion
description: Circular arm sweeps, wrist turning, or rotational twisting motion.

name: Spreading apart or opening
description: Hands or arms pull apart, unfold, tear, or open wide from each other.

name: Converging or closing together
description: Hands or arms move inward to meet, press, clap, or squeeze together.

name: Stepping locomotion
description: Continuous alternating footsteps translating the body across the floor.

name: Airborne jumping motion
description: Explosive upward spring lifting one or both feet off the ground.

name: Balance loss or swaying
description: Unsteady lateral swaying, staggering, or uncontrolled collapse of posture.

name: Sustained static hold
description: Maintaining a steady, low-velocity posture or hand gesture in place.

name: Head tilt to look
description: Tilting the head upward or downward to gaze at a hand, object, or target.

name: Self-body contact
description: Hand touches, rubs, pats, or presses against the person's own body.

name: Hand-to-hand contact
description: Left and right hands directly touch, clap, rub, or clasp against each other.

name: Single-hand object handling
description: One hand grasps, holds, lifts, or swings a handheld object or tool.

name: Bimanual object manipulation
description: Both hands coordinate together to hold, fold, cut, open, or carry an object.

name: Donning garment or accessory
description: Putting on, slipping into, or placing clothing, shoes, eyewear, headwear, or a bag.

name: Doffing garment or accessory
description: Taking off, pulling away, or removing clothing, shoes, eyewear, headwear, or a bag.

name: Operating electronic device
description: Holding, tapping, typing on, or aiming a phone, tablet, camera, or keyboard.

name: Symbolic communicative gesture
description: Forming a deliberate communicative hand posture or finger sign without contact.

name: Friendly interpersonal contact
description: Cooperative physical contact between two people such as hugging, handshaking, patting, or high-five.

name: Interpersonal object exchange
description: Passing, handing over, exchanging, or jointly carrying an object between two people.

name: Aggressive interpersonal action
description: Forceful or threatening strike, push, kick, grab, or weapon aim at another person.

name: Interpersonal proxemic shift
description: Two people approaching, separating, following, or leaning close without forceful strike.

name: Releasing or launching object
description: Letting go of, dropping, tossing, or launching an object into free motion.

name: Single impulsive event
description: A brief single-stroke action with a sharp velocity peak and short duration.

name: Cyclic repetitive pattern
description: Multiple repeating motion cycles performed continuously over several seconds.

name: Sustained stationary phase
description: Action holds a stable body or hand configuration with minimal displacement.

name: Reach-and-retract cycle
description: Two-phase motion reaching out toward a target and returning back to rest.

name: Body or object state transition
description: Clear transition between two distinct start and end postures or wearing states.

name: Continuous ongoing flow
description: Smooth, sustained multi-step activity or continuous locomotion over time.

name: Eating and drinking
description: Bringing food or drink toward the mouth for consumption.

name: Personal grooming and hygiene
description: Brushing, wiping, trimming, or applying cosmetic care to oneself.

name: Dressing and accessories
description: Putting on or removing clothing, footwear, glasses, hats, headphones, or bags.

name: Object and container handling
description: Picking up, dropping, opening, packing, unpacking, or moving everyday objects.

name: Paper and office work
description: Reading, writing, tearing, stapling, cutting, folding, or handling paper and money.

name: Digital device interaction
description: Calling, browsing, typing, or taking photos using a phone, tablet, or keyboard.

name: Greeting and polite gesture
description: Greeting, waving, saluting, bowing, handshaking, or expressing respect and cheer.

name: Expressive communication sign
description: Signaling approval, refusal, silence, victory, stop, pointing, or anger.

name: Health symptom or reflex
description: Experiencing body pain, sneezing, coughing, yawning, nausea, blowing nose, or falling.

name: Posture transition or stretch
description: Sitting down, standing up, squatting low, or stretching the limbs and trunk.

name: Ball sport movement
description: Throwing, shooting, bouncing, juggling, or swinging a racket in sports play.

name: Fitness and calisthenics
description: Jumping, hopping, running in place, arm circles, kicks, or athletic exercise.

name: Social play and support
description: High-five, toasting, whispering, assisting someone, or playing hand games together.

name: Conflict and aggression
description: Punching, kicking, pushing, striking with an object, grabbing, or threatening another person.

name: Spatial navigation and carrying
description: Walking toward, walking apart, following someone, or transporting heavy loads.

name: Micro-fidget and handheld play
description: Snapping fingers, tossing a coin, twisting a puzzle cube, or fanning oneself.
